application_status: planned; no implementation completed by this documentation release

milestones.title: Freeze provenance, licensing and release asset policy
deliverables: Pin every selected code revision, model artifact, feature frontend and conversion-tool version.
Record author licensing statements and required distribution notices for code, weights, fonts, soundfonts, codecs and native providers.
Exclude non-commercial or unverified required assets; distinguish original MT3 from the separately labeled YourMT3+ author checkpoint.
Preserve stable MuseScore base and GPL obligations; define the offline release asset manifest.
tests: Review the ledger against source/model authors and actual selected files, not repository badges alone.
Verify SHA-256 identities and notices; reject an absent or mismatched required artifact.
milestones.completion_gate: A complete versioned code/model/asset ledger exists and all required distribution inputs meet the accepted policy. Research metadata alone does not close this issue.

milestones.title: Prove native YourMT3+ inference feasibility
deliverables: Use the pinned author YPTF+Multi (PS) checkpoint/configuration as the reference.
Export encoder/decoder with cached generation state; implement exact native frontend, vocabulary, event and sustained-note/tie reconstruction.
Validate ONNX CPU/DirectML operation, source offsets, segmentation, short/padded input, EOS and instrument/drum mapping.
Measure working RAM, GPU memory, load times and processing time on the reference hardware; record unsupported operators and changes.
tests: Compare final note events and targeted tensors with identical upstream input/frontend/decode settings.
Use chunk-crossing sustained notes, silence, short clips, dense mixtures and instrument/drum fixtures.
Allow no more than a 0.5 percentage-point fixed-metric loss from an optimized runtime relative to the pinned reference.
milestones.completion_gate: Native recognition is reproducible and its numerical/event, memory and timing report is available. Failure blocks dependent integration; no cloud/external-app substitution is allowed.

milestones.title: Establish the integrated Windows editor and project foundation
deliverables: Create the separately branded C++/Qt application from stable MuseScore 4.7.6 at the recorded commit.
Retain notation, parts, accessibility, undo, playback and symbolic import/export inside SMPL Tones.
Remove required online accounts/cloud/download behavior and integrate local project handling.
Preserve existing research artifacts outside the application source/build changes.
tests: Demonstrate offline MIDI import, note/part editing, undo, playback, MusicXML and PDF export.
Verify first launch without another MuseScore installation or a network connection.
milestones.completion_gate: The branded editor builds and core local symbolic workflows pass focused checks; transcription is not claimed until its later integration.

milestones.title: Implement bounded media processing and recoverable jobs
deliverables: Bundle local media decoding with networking disabled; add microphone, WASAPI system-audio and MIDI capture.
Create waveform/resampling caches and source-time metadata without loading entire long recordings into RAM.
Implement process isolation, queueing, progress, cancellation, atomic artifact finalization and durable stage checkpoints.
Add the working-project journal and recovery behavior separately from full archive save.
tests: Exercise Unicode paths, long/corrupt media, recording-device loss, cancellation, worker crash and disk-full handling.
Restart after a finalized chunk/stage and verify source media and edited score remain intact.
milestones.completion_gate: Media/jobs remain bounded and responsive; completed work survives interruption without corrupting project state.

milestones.title: Integrate versioned replaceable recognition engines
deliverables: Implement Engine manifest v1, Job request v1, Analysis result v1 and Progress/checkpoint v1.
Use process pipes for control/progress and local files or mapped buffers for large data; separate diagnostic output.
Integrate YourMT3+ and native Basic Pitch postprocessing, including optional bends for isolated instruments.
Expose range/instrument/backend controls, model identity, supported capabilities and genuine/nullable confidence.
tests: Swap the two adapters without changing the editor/project contract.
Verify capability mismatch, version mismatch, corrupt/missing assets, note ordering and checkpoint provenance.
Compare Basic Pitch window/bend decoding with the pinned source implementation.
milestones.completion_gate: Both engines run locally through the same contracts with validated results and explicit capabilities; no separately installed interpreter/app is required.

milestones.title: Add beat tracking and musically valid notation preparation
deliverables: Integrate validated Beat This final0 and a smaller draft path with exact frontend/postprocessing.
Build editable tempo maps, downbeat/pickup/meter controls and provisional-state handling.
Implement quantization, rests, ties, tuplets, voices, piano-hand splitting and percussion mapping through score undo operations.
Preserve original performance events independently of written timing.
tests: Use swing, triplets, rubato, sustained notes, pickups and meter-change fixtures.
Verify valid measure durations and that tempo/grid corrections reuse recognition without destroying source timing.
milestones.completion_gate: Recognized events become editable valid notation with inspectable timing assumptions and reproducible source/score alignment.

milestones.title: Build synchronized correction and non-destructive take review
deliverables: Synchronize source/stem audio, waveform, piano roll, score cursor and selection.
Provide loop/slow review, mute/solo, per-part levels, note split/join, pitch/timing edits and reassignment.
Persist transcription identities and alternative takes; compare results against the originating project revision.
Apply selected changes as grouped undoable operations without overwriting newer manual work.
tests: Edit while inference runs, accept/reject an alternative and verify no manual correction disappears.
Save/reopen, undo/redo and recover after a worker failure while checking alignment and identity links.
milestones.completion_gate: A musician can review and correct an automatic result with synchronized playback and safely compare retranscription alternatives.

milestones.title: Add stem separation and detailed local processing
deliverables: Validate a fixed Demucs-based native separation model and documented stem vocabulary.
Implement bounded overlap/reconstruction, reusable stem caches and stem playback.
Run selected-part recognition in detailed mode; preserve comparison alternatives rather than blindly merging notes.
Share job cancellation/recovery/backend and model-resource controls.
tests: Compare separated waveforms and boundaries against the pinned separation reference.
Test leakage/transient artifacts, duplicate/conflicting notes and interrupted separation.
Measure whether detailed processing improves or harms specific fixed-corpus cases instead of asserting universal benefit.
milestones.completion_gate: Separation is a validated optional local stage with coherent stems, bounded resources and reviewable downstream takes.

milestones.title: Add vocals, lyric drafts, chord analysis and score reductions
deliverables: Integrate whisper.cpp with a verified multilingual small model; keep lyric drafts distinct from vocal-note recognition.
Provide editable text and manual syllable alignment; preserve uncertain/no-speech cases.
Add editable chord/key suggestions, melody selection, lead sheets, non-destructive simplification and voice/hand review.
Add guitar/bass/ukulele tablature, tuning, capo and inspectable fingering choices.
tests: Evaluate singing, layered vocals, accompaniment and silent/instrumental sections for draft errors.
Verify lyric edits do not invalidate note recognition and reductions do not overwrite the original score.
Use chord, meter and fretted-instrument fixtures with manual correction and save/reopen.
milestones.completion_gate: All auxiliary results are locally generated, editable and auditable; no perfect lyric/voice/chord accuracy is implied.

milestones.title: Complete integrated score, audio, GP5 and LilyPond exports
deliverables: Finish native project/score, MusicXML, full-score/part PDF and synthesized audio exports.
Provide distinct current-content performance MIDI and written/quantized MIDI, retaining original input separately.
Implement native GP5 and LilyPond text writers; do not assume MuseScore already exports Guitar Pro.
Produce concrete loss/unsupported-construct reports for limited target formats.
tests: Round-trip supported notation/events through compatible MusicXML, MIDI and GP5 readers.
Check tuplets, drums, hands, lyrics, tabs, tempo maps and manual edits.
Inspect affected PDF/part layout and validate the supported LilyPond subset in release tooling.
milestones.completion_gate: The documented modern export set is integrated and supported content survives round trips; unsupported content is reported rather than silently dropped.

milestones.title: Profile, optimize and harden reference workflows
deliverables: Measure cold/warm loads, idle/working RAM, GPU allocations and per-stage/end-to-end timing on the reference CPU/GPU.
Enforce bounded queues/caches and one GPU-heavy stage at a time; select the correct laptop adapter.
Validate any lowering/quantization with the same numerical/transcription gates and preserve CPU operation.
Exercise cancellation, backend retry limits, autosave/atomic saves and project migration under failure.
tests: Compare measured installer/runtime budgets and balanced real-time target with actual data.
Use GPU OOM/reset, full disk, corrupt assets, old projects and repeated worker failures.
Check app-owned required network traffic remains absent.
milestones.completion_gate: A reproducible quality/performance/recovery report exists; regressions or unmet budgets are documented blockers rather than hidden downloads or unsupported speed claims.

milestones.title: Package and validate the complete offline Windows release
deliverables: Build one x64 offline MSI with all required native runtimes, models, fonts, soundfont and codec/provider assets.
Include verified hashes/notices, source/build instructions, source-availability material and release notes.
Validate clean-machine installation and first-use without accounts, internet, another music app or Python.
Require the release-signing input for stable publication; developer packages may remain unsigned.
tests: On a clean offline Windows machine: install, first-launch, import/record, transcribe, edit, play, save/reopen and export.
Verify each required asset and no provider/model download, cloud fallback or update/telemetry requirement.
Check source/checksum/notice artifacts and publish measured hardware/performance conditions.
milestones.completion_gate: The self-contained offline installer and release records satisfy all accepted gates. No public working-release claim is made before this issue completes.
